title: A 200 million dollar machine only one company can build

beats.narration: There's a machine that costs 200 million dollars, and only one company on Earth can build it.
It's made by ASML, a Dutch company most people have never heard of.
The machine uses light to print circuits just nanometers wide onto silicon wafers.
Without it, there are no advanced chips. No Nvidia, no Apple, no modern AI.
That's why ASML holds a near-total monopoly on the most important tool in tech.
Its newest model costs closer to 400 million dollars, and chipmakers are lining up to buy it.
The most powerful company you've never heard of. Follow for more.
